summary: The note describes Alajeró, a municipality on the south coast of La Gomera in the Canary Islands, within the province of Santa Cruz de Tenerife. It lies southwest of the capital, San Sebastián de la Gomera. The name Alajeró refers both to the municipality and to the administrative town that governs it.
one_line: Alajeró is a south-coast municipality on the Canary Island of La Gomera, governed from the town of the same name.
